What is meant by the macro level in chemistry?
questions.a: Properties of substances that you can observe with your senses, for example smell, colour, state of a substance

questions.q: What is meant by the micro level in chemistry?
questions.a: The smallest particles of a substance, which can explain the macro properties of a substance
At the micro level it consists of 1 type of particle/molecule
At the micro level it consists of several types of particles/molecules

questions.q: Describe the smallest particles in a substance
questions.a: They determine the properties of the substance. They move constantly. They attract each other and collide with each other. There is space between them.

questions.q: How do you explain changes of state at the micro level?
questions.a: The distance and attraction between the molecules change, so that they form a solid, liquid or gas

questions.q: How do you explain the difference between the solid and the gas state at the micro level?
questions.a: In the solid state the molecules stay in place and only vibrate on the spot. In a gas the particles move around each other with space between them and collide with each other.

questions.q: How do you explain the liquid state at the micro level?
questions.a: The molecules are close together but can move around each other, so that at the macro level the substance can flow

questions.q: How does a pure substance differ from a mixture when you look at boiling and melting points?
questions.a: Mixtures show a melting and boiling range instead of a melting point and boiling point

questions.q: How does a solution differ from a suspension?

questions.q: What is meant by separating in chemistry?
